description: Read the clipboard: format auto (file paths, else image, else text), text, files or image (returned as an image). Text is capped at max_chars (default 20000). An item a password manager marked concealed is never returned. Universal Clipboard content (copied on another device) is fetched from that device when read and marked remote:true. The clipboard can hold secrets: read it only when the task needs it.
name: mac_clipboard_read
